name: West Ham
headline: Who would you rather watch the match with?
subline: Pick your matchday companion. The Hammers decide the ranking.

cards.name: Billy Bonds
cards.tagline: Never sits down, never backs down, 799 games of grit.

cards.name: Trevor Brooking
cards.tagline: Calm, wise, and will explain exactly why we lost.

cards.name: Julian Dicks
cards.tagline: Will shout at the ref for 90 minutes and mean it.

cards.name: Carlos Tevez
cards.tagline: Silent until the 89th minute, then he saves your season.

cards.name: Bobby Moore
cards.tagline: Flawless composure while the pub falls apart around him.

cards.name: Geoff Hurst
cards.tagline: Brings the hat-trick and the stories that go with it.

cards.name: Paolo Di Canio
cards.tagline: Pure chaos, and the best celebration in the pub.

cards.name: Mark Noble
cards.tagline: Knows every fan by name and cries at the anthem.

cards.name: Harry Redknapp
cards.tagline: Reads the game through the window of a car.

cards.name: Slaven Bilic
cards.tagline: Sings every chant louder than you.

cards.name: Sam Allardyce
cards.tagline: Will tell you 1-0 away is a good result, and he is right.

cards.name: Ron Greenwood
cards.tagline: Quietly explains how the beautiful game should be played.

cards.name: John Lyall
cards.tagline: The calmest man in the stand when it is 0-0.

cards.name: David Moyes
cards.tagline: Nervy, tactical, and sure he can still sort the second half.

cards.name: Ray Winstone
cards.tagline: Gravel voice, proper East End, wins every pub argument.

cards.name: Danny Dyer
cards.tagline: Loud, unfiltered, and will start a chant at 3-0 down.

cards.name: Lennox Lewis
cards.tagline: Calm giant, and nobody argues with his seat.

cards.name: Elijah Wood
cards.tagline: The Green Street convert who knows every word of every song.

cards.name: Keira Knightley
cards.tagline: Pub at 11am and perfectly happy about it.

cards.name: Steve Harris
cards.tagline: Brings the volume and the stories from the road.

cards.name: James Corden
cards.tagline: Never stops talking, mostly about Mark Noble.

cards.name: Nick Frost
cards.tagline: Knows the stats, the line-ups, and who was injured in 2004.

cards.name: John Cleese
cards.tagline: Dry, sarcastic, and will insult the referee with great style.

cards.name: Alfred Hitchcock
cards.tagline: Tense, silent, and enjoying your suffering.

cards.name: Matt Damon
cards.tagline: Polite, quiet, and secretly very invested.
